references.text: Merari's sons, Mahli and Mushi, are also mentioned in the list of the Levitical clans in Numbers.
The clan of Mahli is mentioned among the Levitical clans in the census on the plains of Moab.
1 Chronicles repeats the genealogy of Levi's sons, including Merari with his sons Mahli and Mushi.
Mahli is mentioned as a son of Merari in Levi's genealogy.
Merari's sons, Mahli and Mushi, are listed in connection with the organization of the Levitical service under David.
Merari's sons are mentioned along with Mahli and Mushi in connection with the distribution of the Levitical duties.
Levi's sons Gershon, Kohath, and Merari are mentioned when Jacob's family goes down to Egypt.
Sets the context by listing Levi's three sons, of whom Merari is the focus in Exodus 6:19.
Confirms the existence of the Mahlites and Mushites as Merari's clans, parallel to Exodus.
